cloud.confirmText: The image or the text of the request will be sent to the external service you set up in the settings. Local models work without sending any data.

state.idle: No check has been made yet
state.ready: Version {version} is downloaded and will be installed once the jobs finish

update.askText: Version {current} is installed now. Update PixelIt to version {version}? The update is downloaded and verified, running jobs finish first, and then the application restarts.

about.text: Viewing, editing, batch processing and generation of images. Everything runs on your computer; the application goes online only when you ask it to.
about.modelsText: Downloaded separately at your command on the “Models and AI” page.

viewer.emptyTitle: Open a folder or drop images here
viewer.emptyText: JPEG, PNG, WebP, AVIF, JPEG XL, HEIC, TIFF, RAW, SVG, PDF, PSD and other formats are supported. {keys} pastes an image from the clipboard.
viewer.pasteHint: There is no image in the clipboard
viewer.trashText: Files: {count}. You can restore them from the Recycle Bin.
viewer.trashTextMac: Files: {count}. You can restore them from the Trash.

output.formatAutoHint: Each image is saved in whichever of the chosen formats gives the smaller file.
output.losslessHint: Pixels are kept exactly; the file is larger.
output.targetBytesHint: The quality is chosen so that the file fits into the given size.
output.targetScoreHint: Similarity to the original from 0 to 100. The smallest file that reaches it is chosen.
output.replaceOriginalHint: The sources go to the Recycle Bin; the operation can be undone in the history.
output.backgroundHint: Used in formats without transparency, such as JPEG.
output.author: Author

op.shareOfShortSide: In percent of the short side of the image
op.shareOfWidth: In percent of the image width
op.drawHint: Draw with the mouse right on the image.
op.drawInEditor: Drawn with the mouse in the editor.
op.maskHint: Paint over what should be removed.
op.promptHint: Filled in when a generator draws the painted area. Empty: the area is filled from its surroundings.
op.keepHint: Paint over what must stay: background removal leaves these places untouched.
op.editPromptHint: Describe what the picture or the marked area should become.
op.editAreaHint: Paint over the place to change. With nothing marked the whole picture is changed.
op.editStrengthHint: The higher the value, the further the result is from the original picture.
op.generatorMissing: This step needs an image generator.
op.detailAbout: The generator goes over the picture and adds fine detail; what it shows stays. On saving, the file is painted at its full size.
op.detailAreaHint: Paint over the place that needs detail. With nothing marked the whole picture is gone over.
op.detailPromptHint: Describe the picture as it is: the generator paints the detail from this text. An empty field sends “{prompt}”.
op.promptFromFile: Take the prompt from the file
op.promptFromFileHint: The prompt the picture was generated with, when the file keeps it.
op.detailStrengthHint: How far the generator may move from the picture. 25 to 45 is usually enough for detail.
op.asInStudioHint: The steps, the prompt adherence, the sampler, the VAE, the LoRA files and the embeddings the studio remembers for this model.

editor.emptyText: Choose a file, drop it into the window or paste it from the clipboard.
editor.targetMissed: The target cannot be reached; the closest result is shown.
editor.discardText: Changes to “{name}” have not been exported.
editor.exportSkipped: The file was skipped: it already exists
editor.brushHint: Drag over the picture with the left mouse button held down. The slider and the [ and ] keys change the brush size.
editor.brushIdle: To paint with the brush, press “{button}”.
editor.textHint: Type the text and click on the image.

batch.emptyText: Add files or folders, drop them into the window or send them from the viewer.
batch.overwriteText: With these settings existing files are overwritten or replaced. The previous versions go to the Recycle Bin, and the operation can be undone in the history.

recipes.name: Name
recipes.pinned: Pin to the top of the list

builtinText.web: Up to 1920 pixels, WebP or AVIF, whichever is smaller, without metadata.
builtinText.smallest: Picks the format and quality that give the smallest file without visible loss.
builtinText.email: Up to 1600 pixels, JPEG no larger than 500 KB.
builtinText.png: Re-saves as PNG with maximum compression.
builtinText.clean: Removes metadata; the format and the size stay the same.
builtinText.thumbnail: Up to 400 pixels, WebP, slightly sharpened; _thumb is added to the name.

watch.recipeHint: Every new image in the folder is processed with this recipe.
watch.settleHint: How many milliseconds a file must stay unchanged before it is processed.
watch.emptyText: PixelIt can watch a folder and process new images with the recipe you choose.

journal.emptyText: Finished operations appear here. Replacing and deleting files can be undone.
journal.undoText: Created files go to the Recycle Bin; replaced and deleted ones are restored.
journal.undoneLeft: Left alone: changed after the operation — {changed}, not found — {missing}
journal.clearText: The records will be removed and these operations can no longer be undone. The files stay where they are.

tools.folderHint: The files of the set are created in this folder.

about.icons: Icon sets for Windows, websites, Android and iOS from a single image.
about.social: Covers and post images in the sizes of popular platforms.
about.webKit: A responsive set: several widths and formats plus ready HTML code.
about.collage: A grid of several images in one file.
about.pdf: A multi-page PDF made of images.
about.animation: An animated GIF, WebP or APNG from a sequence of frames.
about.duplicates: Finds identical and similar images in a folder.
about.capture: A shot of the whole screen that opens in the editor right away.

webKit.widthsHint: In pixels, separated by commas or spaces.
webKit.formatsHint: The most modern format comes first in the code, the fallback comes last.

pdf.dpiHint: Dots per inch: defines the page size.
pdf.title: Document title

animation.sizeHint: 0 uses the size of the first frame.

duplicates.toleranceHint: 0 finds identical images only; the higher the value, the more different images count as similar.

settings.memoryHint: How many megabytes batch processing may hold in decoded images.
settings.confirmDelete: Ask before moving to the Recycle Bin
settings.downloadFolderHint: Images from the web are saved here. Empty: the downloads folder in the PixelIt data.
settings.pdfiumHint: Needed when PDFium is installed by hand. Empty: the downloaded component is used.
settings.closeToTray: Minimize to the notification area on close
settings.closeToTrayMac: Stay in the menu bar when the window is closed
settings.contextMenu: PixelIt item in the Explorer context menu
settings.captureHotkeyHint: The shortcut works while PixelIt is running.
settings.channelHint: The beta channel gets versions earlier, and they may contain bugs.
settings.updatePortable: The portable version is updated by hand: download the new archive from the releases page.
settings.updatePortableMac: This copy is updated by hand. Move PixelIt to the Applications folder to let it update itself.
settings.updateAsk: PixelIt tells about a new version and asks whether to install it. Nothing is downloaded without your consent.

studio.noProviderText: Connect ComfyUI, Forge, the built-in generator or a cloud service on the “Models and AI” page.
studio.promptHint: Describe what the image should show.
studio.cfgHint: The higher the value, the more closely the model follows the text.
studio.sourceHint: Optional: an image to rework according to the prompt.
studio.strengthHint: 0 keeps the image as it is, 1 draws it anew.
studio.slow: Without a graphics card, generation on this computer takes several minutes per image.
studio.cloudSizeHint: An outside service accepts only some sizes. When it refuses the size set here, PixelIt asks for the nearest allowed one of the same shape.
studio.modelLockedHint: This workflow has no %checkpoint% placeholder, so the model list stays off.
studio.improveMissing: Choose an assistant model on the Models and AI page.
studio.embedParameters: Write the prompt into the file
studio.brushHint: Paint the area to change. [ and ] change the brush size. An empty area changes the whole picture.
studio.expandHint: The generator paints past the edges. The original picture stays as it is.
studio.upscaleMissing: Install the upscale model on the Models and AI page.
studio.historyEmptyText: Pictures you generate are kept here.
studio.deleteText: Move {count} pictures to the recycle bin?
studio.stylePromptHint: {prompt} is replaced by the prompt. Otherwise the text is added after a comma.
studio.enlargeHint: Every picture is enlarged with the chosen upscaler right after it is generated.
studio.upscaleInstallText: Enlarging needs the local model {name} ({size}). Download and install it?
studio.upscaleInstalling: The enlargement model is downloading. The picture is enlarged right after that.
studio.upscalerNeedsServer: needs a running ComfyUI or Forge
studio.upscalerMissing: This model is not available right now. Refresh the list when the program is running.
studio.upscaleRefineHint: The generator paints the enlarged picture again, so fine detail comes back. This takes about as long as generating the picture.
studio.upscaleFastHint: Only the upscaler runs. Quicker, and no new detail is added.
studio.upscaleStrengthHint: How far the generator may move from the enlarged picture. Lower keeps it closer.
studio.noticeNeedsGenerator: Detail needs ComfyUI or Forge. The picture was only enlarged.
studio.noticeNoPrompt: This picture has no prompt stored, so it was only enlarged.
studio.noticeRefineFailed: The generator did not answer, so the picture was only enlarged.
studio.tuningSilent: The generator does not answer, so the lists are empty. Start it and press Refresh.
studio.samplerHint: The sampler and the scheduler decide sharpness and fine detail. Euler a or DPM++ 2M with the Karras scheduler are common choices.
studio.vaeHint: A separate VAE is needed when the model has none built in: the picture then comes out washed out or blurry.
studio.loraHint: The number is the strength of the LoRA. Usually between 0.6 and 1.
studio.refineHint: The generator goes over the picture once more and paints in fine detail. The size stays the same.
studio.zoomHint: The mouse wheel zooms, a drag moves the picture, a double click brings it back to fit.
studio.embeddingHint: An embedding works as a word of the prompt. The chosen ones are added to the prompt or to what to avoid by themselves.

vision.noModelText: Choose a model that understands images on the “Models and AI” page.
vision.applyHint: Without this mark the result is only shown.

about.describe: A detailed description of what the image shows.
about.altText: A short caption for websites and screen readers.
about.name: A meaningful file name based on the content.
about.ocr: Reads the text in the image.

web.linkHint: Link to a Pinterest pin, a web page or an image
web.linkAbout: An image behind a direct link is downloaded at once. For a page, PixelIt shows the images found on it and you choose the ones you need. No account is needed.
web.queryHint: What to look for, e.g. red fox
web.searchNote: The text of the query goes to {host}. This catalogue holds freely licensed images; the author and the license are shown under each image.
web.downloadEdit: Download and open in the editor
web.editOne: Select one image for the editor
web.rights: Images on the web belong to their authors. Before using someone else’s work, check the license and the terms of the site. The source of every download, and the author and the license when they are known, are kept in the history.
web.nothingText: Try another query or another source.
web.emptyText: Paste a link or type a query, and the images found appear here. A link can be pasted with {keys} from anywhere in the application.

ai.adviceGpu: The graphics card is suitable for running models.
ai.adviceCpu: Models will run on the processor: slower, with the same result.
ai.starterHint: Background removal, upscaling, object removal and face restoration
ai.removeText: The files of “{name}” will be deleted from the disk. You can download the component again later.
ai.privacyText: Local models and servers on this computer work without sending any data. External services receive your images and texts.
ai.localServersText: Looks for Ollama, LM Studio, ComfyUI, Forge and Fooocus running on this computer.
ai.visionText: Describes images, suggests tags and names, reads text. Any model that accepts images and has an OpenAI-compatible API will do.
ai.assistantText: Runs the chat and calls PixelIt tools. A model with tool calling is required.
ai.keyHint: Kept in Windows Credential Manager for {host}.
ai.keyHintMac: Kept in the macOS Keychain for {host}.
ai.checkpointHint: Name of the model on the server. Empty: the model chosen on the server itself.
ai.workflowHint: A workflow file in API format. Empty: the built-in text-to-image workflow.
ai.sdcppModelHint: A Stable Diffusion model file in GGUF or safetensors format.

providerText.comfy: A ComfyUI server running on this computer or in your network.
providerText.forge: A Forge or AUTOMATIC1111 server started with the --api option.
providerText.sdCpp: stable-diffusion.cpp from PixelIt components and your model file.
providerText.cloud: A service with an OpenAI-compatible image API and your key.

kindText.runtime: ONNX Runtime with DirectML: required by every built-in model.
kindText.pdf: PDFium: opens PDF pages as images.
kindText.generator: stable-diffusion.cpp: generation without a separate server.
kindText.background: Separates the subject from the background.
kindText.upscale: Enlarges an image and restores details.
kindText.inpaint: Fills the painted area from its surroundings.

ai.keyPaste: Paste the key: it is saved at once
ai.allowCloudText: The server {host} is outside this computer, and outside services are switched off now. Allow PixelIt to reach them? The settings on this page will be saved.
ai.forgeCheckpointHint: The name as Forge lists it. Empty keeps the model already loaded there.

apps.title: Applications
apps.text: Install ComfyUI or Forge, start and stop them, and keep one set of model folders.
apps.foreignUpdate: This copy is updated by whoever installed it.
apps.modelsText: ComfyUI receives every folder. Forge receives one folder of each kind.
apps.searchText: The same catalogues Stability Matrix searches. A file is downloaded only when you ask, into the first folder of its kind.
apps.notInFolder: The program was not found in this folder
apps.logEmpty: The log is empty. It fills in after a start.
apps.logCut: Only the end of the log is shown. The file has all of it.

assistant.emptyText: Describe the task in your own words: “shrink the photos in the folder to 1600 pixels and remove the location”. The assistant works with PixelIt tools inside the allowed folders.
assistant.noModelText: Choose a model with tool calling on the “Models and AI” page.
assistant.approveText: The assistant wants to call the tool “{name}” with these arguments:

mcp.serverText: Add this fragment to the settings of Cursor, Claude Desktop or another MCP client, and its agent will be able to process images through PixelIt.
mcp.accessText: Applies to the built-in assistant and to external agents connected to the MCP server.
mcp.foldersNone: The list is empty: agents have no access to any folder.
mcp.allowDelete: Moving files to the Recycle Bin
mcp.allowDownloads: Downloading models, components and images from the web
mcp.clientsText: The tools of these servers are available to the assistant.
mcp.commandHint: The program PixelIt starts and talks to through standard input and output.
mcp.envHint: One per line: NAME=value. Kept in Windows Credential Manager.
mcp.envHintMac: One per line: NAME=value. Kept in the macOS Keychain.
mcp.urlHint: Address of a server with the Streamable HTTP transport.
mcp.defaultPermissionHint: Applies to tools without a rule of their own.
mcp.removeText: Server “{name}” will be removed from the list.

errors.agentPathDenied: The path is outside the folders allowed to agents: {path}

errors.aiWorkerFailed: The model process ended with an error

errors.badKey: The key contains characters that are not allowed
errors.badPage: The file has no such page
errors.badResponse: The server answered in an unexpected form
errors.badWorkflow: The ComfyUI workflow cannot be read or is not saved in API format
errors.captionUnsupported: A description can be written only into JPEG and PNG

errors.providerNotSet: The service is not set up on the “Models and AI” page

errors.responseTooLarge: The answer of the server is too large

errors.tooLargeForFormat: The image is too large for this format
errors.toolDeclined: The call of the tool “{name}” was declined
errors.trashFailed: Could not move to the Recycle Bin
errors.undoNotFound: This operation can no longer be undone
errors.unsupportedFormat: The file format is not supported

errors.watchFailed: Could not start watching the folder
errors.keyMissing: The server {host} asks for an access key. Enter the key in the field below and try again.
errors.updatePortable: The portable version is updated by hand
errors.builtinStyle: A built-in style cannot be changed or removed.

errors.appLaunchFailed: The program could not be started

notify.updateAvailableText: Version {version} is out. Download it from the PixelIt releases page.
notify.updateAskText: Version {version} is out. Open PixelIt to install it.
